w: Swamishri established a Yuvak Mandal in Harare.
Grand welcome at airport. Minister for Tourism and Wildlife, Hon. Henry Kosagi, welcomed Swamishri.
ph: Welcomed at the old Swaminarayan mandir, Nagara road, Nairobi, 21 Aug 99

w: In the evening assembly the local balaks enacted the transformation of Shitaldas on seeing Shriji Maharaj's divinity. Then a balak performed a dance with dishes in hand. And lastly, a balak performed a mono-acting on the transformation of Magniram. Swamishri finally appreciated the performances and blessed the assembly.
